ToolRegistry.execute now validates input against the resolved
definition's inputSchema before calling the executor and returns a
ToolResponse naming the failing paths and constraints - never the
offending values - so the model can correct a malformed call within
the tool-round budget. Static schemas stay compiled once at register;
function-valued sources resolve per call, cached by schema object.

Fixes the red build: ajv v6 has no named Ajv export (default import),
the register-throw rethrow now carries its cause, and the orchestrator
loop test reads its tool_result without tripping the member-chain and
early-return rules.
